best_idea: The engine stamps the time and the caller, checks a per-identity window before any action work, and on rejection writes nothing and returns a typed error.
decision_why: The gate shape fits intake, but Frankendom must return a typed RATE_LIMITED result instead of a panic, key the window per action kind, count server ticks instead of wall-clock microseconds, and guarantee no state change on rejection, because kills are server-verified and the server tick is the clock.
acceptance: A server test sends two engage intents from one identity closer together than the window; the second returns RATE_LIMITED with a retry-after value and the duel state and ledger are unchanged, and an intent after the window is accepted.
